- Per Share Merger Consideration: cash equal to the Offer Price (3.15 per share). - Option Consideration: cash equal to (Per Share Merger Consideration minus exercise price) times the number of shares underlying each Option with exercise price below the Per Share Merger Consideration. - RSU Consideration: cash equal to Per Share Merger Consideration times the number of shares underlying each RSU. - PSU Consideration: cash equal to Per Share Merger Consideration times the vested portion underlying PSUs; unvested PSUs cancelled with no payment. - Merger Sub: 1-for-1 stock exchange (Merger Sub shares convert into Surviving Corporation shares). - No CVRs or other non-cash forms of consideration are provided. - Dissenters’ Rights: Dissenting Shares generally do not receive Per Share Merger Consideration unless appraisal rights are not properly perfected.
Cash per-share consideration: each share of Common Stock outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time will be automatically converted into the right to receive cash equal to the Offer Price; there is no stock-for-stock exchange ratio described.
